description: Paid endpoint ($0.01): one-call market scan for trading agents. For the watchlist plus every coin in the current news snapshots (up to 25), or the symbols you pass (1-20), returns Hyperliquid perp state (mark, oracle, 24h change, funding hourly/8h/annualized, OI in USD, 24h volume, premium, extreme-funding rank) joined with news sentiment (score, label, counts, top headlines) and headline attention vs 7-day average, plus neutral flags (funding_extreme, attention_spike, news_active). Facts only, no recommendation. Unknown symbols, bad params or stale data return an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/perps-context

symbols.description: Optional Hyperliquid main-dex tickers; omit for the default set (watchlist + coins in the news)

name: get_perps_context
title: Perps + news context, many coins (paid, x402) — $0.01

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
